name: insurance-ad-manager
description: Multi-platform insurance ad management & campaign automation (React + Express + MySQL)

scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d && npm --prefix server run db:wait
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix server run db:generate && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
